mapper.sql: r.id, r.tournament_id, r.user_id, r.seed, r.status, r.checked_in, r.checked_in_at, r.final_placement, r.wins, r.losses, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tournament_registrations (tournament_id, user_id, seed, status, checked_in, checked_in_at, final_placement, wins, losses, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tournamentId}, #{userId}, #{seed}, #{status}, 0, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT , u.nickname, u.username, u.avatar_url, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_admin FROM tournament_registrations r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT , u.nickname, u.username, u.avatar_url, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_admin FROM tournament_registrations r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND r.status = 'registered' ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.final_placement IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.final_placement ASC, COALESCE(r.seed, 9999) ASC, r.created_at ASC

SELECT , u.nickname, u.username, u.avatar_url, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_admin, t.title AS tournament_title, t.status AS tournament_status, t.starts_at AS tournament_starts_at, t.created_at AS tournament_created_at FROM tournament_registrations r INNER JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = r.tournament_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'registered' ORDER BY COALESCE(t.starts_at, t.created_at) DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tournament_registrations WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND status = 'registered'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tournament_registrations WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND status = 'registered' AND checked_in = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tournament_registrations SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tournament_registrations SET seed = #{seed}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tournament_registrations SET checked_in = 1, checked_in_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'registered'
UPDATE tournament_registrations SET final_placement = #{finalPlacement}, wins = #{wins}, losses = #{losses}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tournament_registrations SET status = 'withdrawn', updated_at = NOW() WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'registered'
